patients.summary: Office administrator with long-standing hypertension, diet-controlled type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia and bipolar I disorder on lithium, who joins in 2021. An ACE-inhibitor cough in 2023 is followed by hard-to-control hypertension from right renal artery stenosis, flash pulmonary edema and a renal stent in 2025, and two lithium toxicities (2025, 2026), after which hydrochlorothiazide is stopped.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT VISIT

CC: Here to establish care. Leaving her previous primary care office after it changed hands; records release signed today.

HPI: 54-year-old woman, office administrator, with several long-running issues, all fairly settled.
- Hypertension: on metoprolol succinate 50, amlodipine 10 and HCTZ 25 for years. Checks at the pharmacy kiosk now and then, usually 130s/80s. No headaches, chest pain or swelling.
- Type 2 diabetes: told years ago; managed with diet only, never on medication. Tries to keep carbs down at lunch. No polyuria, no foot numbness.
- Cholesterol: atorvastatin 40, aspirin 81. No muscle aches.
- Bipolar I disorder and depression: followed by her outside psychiatrist, who prescribes lithium 300 twice daily and sertraline 100. Mood steady for a long while. Psychiatry has been getting lithium levels; she would like us to do her blood work here and copy them.

PMH: as above. No surgeries.
Meds: metoprolol succinate 50 daily, amlodipine 10 daily, HCTZ 25 qAM, atorvastatin 40 daily, ASA 81 daily, lithium carbonate 300 BID, sertraline 100 daily.
Allergies: shellfish (cannot remember what happened, avoids it).
FH: father with hypertension and type 2 diabetes. Mother with high cholesterol, had a stroke at 68. Maternal aunt with bipolar disorder. Brother had an MI at 52.
SH: lives alone in Florence. Never smoked. A drink or two a month, socially. Works full time in an office.

ROS: negative except as in HPI.

Exam: vitals in flowsheet. Well appearing, pleasant. HEENT unremarkable, no thyromegaly. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities without edema; feet with intact skin, good pulses, monofilament intact bilaterally. Neuro grossly nonfocal, no tremor.

A/P:
1. Hypertension, at goal today on three drugs. Continue.
2. Type 2 diabetes, diet-controlled. A1c and urine albumin today. Will want yearly eye exam; she has an optometrist.
3. Hyperlipidemia. Continue atorvastatin 40 and aspirin. Lipids today.
4. Bipolar I disorder / depression, stable with psychiatry. Lithium level, TSH, calcium and creatinine today; results will be faxed to psychiatry.
5. Health maintenance: hep C and HIV screens offered and accepted. Prior records requested for colonoscopy, Pap and vaccines. Mammogram ordered. Flu shot when supply arrives next month.

RTC 6 months, sooner as needed.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Ms. Desrosiers, your labs from Tuesday look good. A1c is in the diabetes range but stable with diet alone, so no medication needed. Cholesterol is well controlled on the atorvastatin. Kidney function, calcium and thyroid are normal, and your lithium level is right in the usual range; I've faxed a copy to your psychiatrist. Hepatitis C and HIV screens were negative. Talk soon.

documents.title: Prior Primary Care Records Received
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Records received by fax from prior PCP office, 46 pages, scanned to media.

Abstracted:
- Problem list matches what pt reported: HTN, type 2 DM (diet), hyperlipidemia, bipolar I disorder, depression.
- Colonoscopy 06/2018: normal, no polyps; repeat in 10 years.
- Pap with HPV co-test 2019: negative/negative.
- Tdap 05/2017.
- COVID vaccine, Pfizer, 2 doses 03/2021 and 04/2021 (copy of card in records).
- Mammogram 2019 benign; no 2020 study on file.
- Allergy list: shellfish.

Immunizations entered. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In for flu vaccine and COVID booster (last Pfizer dose 04/2021). Screening questions negative, no prior reactions. Flu vaccine L deltoid, Pfizer booster R deltoid, lots and VIS documented. Waited 15 min, felt fine, left ambulatory.

reports.text: Bilateral screening mammogram with tomosynthesis. Comparison: outside study 2019. Breasts are scattered fibroglandular density. No suspicious mass, architectural distortion or suspicious calcifications. Skin and nipples unremarkable.

documents.title: Refill Request
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pharmacy fax requesting 90-day supply for metoprolol succinate, amlodipine, HCTZ and atorvastatin, pt switching to mail order through her insurance. Last visit 9/2021, BP at goal. Sent 90 days x 1 refill each per protocol. Lithium and sertraline come from psychiatry.

documents.title: Diabetic Eye Examination Report
documents.author: optometry
documents.body:
Diabetic eye exam, dilated, performed 02/03/2022.
VA 20/20 OD, 20/25 OS with correction. IOP 15/16. Anterior segments quiet. Dilated fundus exam: no diabetic retinopathy either eye, no macular edema. Mild presbyopia, glasses updated.
Recommend repeat dilated exam in 12 months.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: 6-month check. Doing well. Busy season at work. Diet so-so over the holidays, better now. Home BPs mostly 128-136/80s. No CP, SOB, edema. Mood good, last saw psychiatry in January. No tremor, no GI upset.

O: see vitals. Lungs clear, RRR, no edema. Feet: skin intact, pulses 2+, sensation normal.

A/P:
- HTN: at goal, same three meds.
- T2DM, diet: A1c today.
- Bipolar I on lithium: level and BMP today, copy to psychiatry.
- Shingrix #1 today; #2 in 2-6 months.
RTC for physical in September.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs are fine. A1c a bit better than September, kidney function normal, lithium level in range. Keep doing what you're doing.

documents.title: Re: Lab Results
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Thank you! My arm was sore from the shingles shot for 2 days but its fine now. I'll book the second one.

documents.title: Psychiatry Progress Letter
documents.author: psychiatry
documents.body:
Re: Patricia Desrosiers, DOB 10/26/1966

Seen for medication management 05/10/2022. Bipolar I disorder with a history of depressive episodes, euthymic for several years. Sleeping well, working full time, no hypomanic symptoms, no suicidal thinking. Fine tremor absent. Continue lithium carbonate 300 mg twice daily and sertraline 100 mg daily. Thank you for drawing her lithium levels; the March level was therapeutic. Please continue every 6 months with TSH, calcium and creatinine yearly. Next visit in 6 months.

Outpatient psychiatry

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Shingrix #2 given R deltoid, lot and exp recorded. Dose 1 was 3/24/22. Series complete. Pt tolerated well.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PREVENTIVE VISIT

Interval: no illnesses or ER visits this year. Feels well. Walking at lunch most days. Mood stable, sees psychiatry twice a year. Home BP in range.

Meds reviewed, no changes: metoprolol succinate 50, amlodipine 10, HCTZ 25, atorvastatin 40, ASA 81, lithium 300 BID, sertraline 100.
Allergies: shellfish.

ROS negative. PHQ-9 = 2.

Exam: NAD. HEENT normal, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Breasts: deferred to imaging per her preference. Abdomen soft, no bruits appreciated, no organomegaly. Ext no edema. Feet intact, pulses 2+, monofilament normal. Neuro nonfocal, no tremor.

A/P:
- HTN controlled. Continue.
- T2DM, diet only: A1c, UACR. Eye exam done in February, no retinopathy.
- HLD: lipids on atorvastatin 40.
- Bipolar I / depression stable: lithium level, TSH, calcium, creatinine.
- Prevention: PCV20 today given diabetes. Flu today. Shingrix complete. Colonoscopy 2018 normal, next 2028. Pap/HPV 2019 negative, next 2024. Mammogram ordered.

RTC 6 months.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Physical labs are back and look stable: A1c unchanged, cholesterol well controlled, kidney, thyroid and calcium normal, no protein in the urine, lithium in range. Copy sent to your psychiatrist.

reports.text: Bilateral screening mammogram with tomosynthesis, compared with 11/2021 and 2019. Scattered areas of fibroglandular density. No suspicious mass, calcification or distortion. Stable appearance.

documents.title: Psychiatry Progress Letter
documents.author: psychiatry
documents.body:
Re: Patricia Desrosiers

Seen 11/29/2022. Stable mood through the fall, no depressive symptoms despite the shorter days. Continue lithium carbonate 300 mg BID and sertraline 100 mg daily. September lithium level from your office therapeutic. Return in 6 months.

Outpatient psychiatry
